syntheses of allenols via HAT-mediated propargyl
radical generation†

Received 8th July 2024,

Selectivity control of the reactions of propargylic and/or allenylic radicals remains particularly elusive.
Here, a visible light-mediated Cu-catalyzed protocol for the highly selective syntheses of tri- and tetra-
substituted allenols from alkynol derivatives has been developed. The synthetic potential of the products
has been demonstrated. The control experiments, Stern–Volmer quenching, and cyclic voltammetry
studies support a reaction pathway involving the generation of allenyl radicals <sub>v</sub>i<sub>a</sub> photo-mediated N–O
bond scission, an intramolecular 1,5-HAT process, the resonance to propargylic radicals, and coupling. A
non-common intramolecular 1,6-HAT process has also been observed.
